decoration: moderate — a few SVG blobs or grid lines
hero_layout: centered — everything stacked in the middle
hero_cta_style: floating action buttons with hover effects
hero_height: auto — natural content height, no forced height
nav_style: side dots — floating dot indicators on the side
hover_effects: subtle — slight lift or color shift on cards
contact_style: big bold email as hero text
quirk: use a prominent number/counter design element for sections (01, 02, 03...)
